title: Ring Construct System (Instant, Sustained, Guided)
description: Implements the Green Lantern ring construct loop with three layers: (A) Instant constructs (energy bolt, fist, sword, round shield, barrier wall); (B) Sustained constructs (dome shield, energy cage, continuous beam) draining ring_energy over time; (C) Guided freeform shaping for simple walls/platforms via right-grip shaping with translucent previews, size/orient, and finalize on right-trigger. Input: hold Y to open a radial category wheel (categories: Attack, Defense/Control, Utility); release to select; Right Trigger activates/spawns; Right Grip scales/orients during preview; Left Trigger toggles targeting/locking assist. Includes placement guides, target highlights, invalid-placement feedback, haptics, timed despawn for instant constructs, sustained drain with early-stop on release or low energy, and auto-cleanup. Integrates with ring_energy resource (query/consume/refund on cancel) provided by ring_charge_and_recharge; updates diegetic ring HUD via events. Uses Construct VFX/Materials for previews and final visuals. Exposes JSON config: input bindings, construct cost table (spawn + per-second drain), max concurrent constructs by type, freeform snap grid/rules, preview tinting, and scene-specific limits.
acceptance_notes:
- Hold Y opens radial; releasing on Basic Attack shows icon and enables Right Trigger energy bolts, fist, sword, round shield. Round shield blocks turret fire.
- Defense/Control allows sustained dome shield and energy cage on drone; ring_energy drains while held; releasing ends construct.
- Right Grip shaping enables freeform wall/platform preview with green VFX; Right Trigger finalizes; invalid placement shows warning and cancels without charge.
- Haptics and VFX present; constructs auto-clean when energy is insufficient or on exit.
